contract.input: same-type native FP16 or BF16 X[T,K], W[N,K], row-major compact
contract.output: independent FP16/BF16 Y[T,ldy] with FP32 local accumulation and one 16-bit store
contract.format_status: all four dispatches source-instantiated for both tiles; compile/numerics UNRUN
contract.t: positive dynamic incl 1,3,17,160,8192; logical-M surfaces preserve tail bounds
contract.n: positive multiple64; no unsupported N tail assumption
contract.k: positive multiple32; short K=32/64 prefetch clamped; K tails rejected
contract.surface_limit: width bytes/pitch bytes/height <=0xFFFFFF; complete byte rectangles and work-item count <=INT_MAX
contract.ownership: borrowed Runtime/queue; registered Allocation lifetime retained by caller, no concurrent destruction; checked drain required by fixture before unwind
contract.queue: supplied same Runtime domain, in-order, Level Zero Intel GPU; no adapter queue, device0, retry, memcpy, CPU inference fallback or scratch
contract.device: actual architecture query BMG G21/G31, SG16, group/local-dim>=128; FP16 support queried once
contract.platform: Linux LP64 required by pinned long payload ABI; Windows LLP64 blocked explicitly
contract.ftz_target: strict gradual-underflow comparisons; actual DPAS/input/store FTZ behavior UNESTABLISHED, mismatch fails, no relaxed pass

resource_estimate_limits: No SLM requested, no global FP32 temporaries. Operand/reorder replication, compiler spills, occupancy and actual registers UNRUN; GRF256 is a property request, not proof.
remaining_compile_gates: Approved official LLVM/ocloc must accept pinned TLA block2D payload builtins, inline vISA, SG16/GRF256 properties and split-barrier translator options.
Public TLA copy/reorder selectors must compile row-major W and independent FP16/BF16 D at padded ldy for both tiles.
Actual generated code and all 8 IO/tile instantiations must be inspected/qualified; source path alone is not proof of DPAS or absence of device-library emulation.
AOT recipe defaults to bmg-g21-a0; use explicit bmg-g31-a0 for that device, no auto-retry.
Numerical subnormal/rounding/NaNInf and lifetime/fault gates remain UNRUN; no claim of performance or model correctness.

retention.artifacts: only compact source/docs/manifest hashes; no generated binary/log/tensor/trace
retention.next_review: Main reviews package; after component qualification reconsider external worktree and any future raw diagnostics

commands_executed: Orca dispatch check/heartbeat/send help; worker_done will be sent once

cpu_path_audit.adapter_host: dimension/extent guards, cached capability, registered-span validation, queue submit only
cpu_path_audit.device: block2D loads/prefetch -> register reorder -> XE_DPAS_TT<float accum> -> typed register reorder -> block2D 16-bit store
cpu_path_audit.transitive_compat: cutlass/gpu_generics.h includes Apache-LLVM compatibility headers; lazy dev_mgr not called
cpu_path_audit.bf16_constructor: pinned cutlass/bfloat16.h selects __spirv_ConvertFToBF16INTEL for Intel device compilation instead of unconditional devicelib; emitted branch/binary still UNRUN
cpu_path_audit.not_proven: actual DPAS/device-library lowering, no spill/emulation claims; Main binary review required

fixture_suites.guards: 26 synchronous rejects incl alignment/extent/overlap/overflow/context/host+foreign USM/beta/types/tile/queue; no valid submit; verify X/W/Y unchanged
fixture_suites.smoke: both tiles x all4 IO, T1/3/17/160, N128 K64 ldy136
fixture_suites.edges: both tiles x all4 IO at T17 N64 ldy72 K32/64; exact FP32 cancellation/RNE/special classification
fixture_suites.chain: both tiles x input FP16/BF16 x final FP16/BF16, BF16 intermediate direct supplied-queue dependency
fixture_suites.oracles: independent CPU FP64 dyadic closed form and arithmetic bit decode/RNE; NaN by class, Inf sign, zero magnitude; strict gradual-underflow initially
fixture_suites.lifetime: CheckedDrain declared after all async USM/host-vector owners, including raw unregistered-USM fixture; checked drain before unwind or fail-stop
